item.title: Byakugan Scan — Instant, in-memory screen OCR, QR code, and barcode scanner for macOS built with Swift 6.0 and Apple Vision Framework. Zero telemetry, sub-50ms hotkeys.
item.description:
Byakugan Scan is a native macOS menu bar utility for instant, in-memory screen OCR, QR code, and barcode recognition. Unlike conventional screenshot OCR tools that write temporary image files to disk and trigger Spotlight or media analysis daemons, Byakugan Scan captures selected screen regions directly into NSPasteboard memory as a CGImage buffer and processes them on the Apple Neural Engine in under 50ms—with zero temporary files, zero network calls, and zero external Swift package dependencies.

Official Dedicated Webpage: https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud

Source Code Repository: https://github.com/halcyon-past/byakugan-scan

Tech Stack: Swift 6.0, AppKit, SwiftUI, Apple Vision Framework, Neural Engine, macOS 14+, Homebrew Cask
item.author: aritrosaha2025@gmail.com (Aritro Saha)

item.title: SutraKey — Instant Shift+Select radial pie menu for video, audio, and clean document actions on macOS
item.description:
SutraKey (सूत्र) is a native, lightweight macOS utility designed as an invisible thread connecting text selection to instant media and document actions. When you hold Shift and select any URL or text, an under-cursor radial pie menu smoothly appears, letting you download videos, extract high-bitrate audio, pull clean subtitles, scrape gallery images, or generate ad-free reader-mode PDFs directly into ~/Downloads—with 0% idle CPU and zero background bloat.

Official Dedicated Webpage: https://sutrakey.aritro.cloud

Source Code Repository: https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey

Tech Stack: Swift 6.0, AppKit, SwiftUI, CGEventTap, macOS 14+ Sonoma, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, Homebrew Cask
item.author: aritrosaha2025@gmail.com (Aritro Saha)

item.title: OpenWorld Portfolio — Interactive 2.5D retro Pokémon-inspired open-world developer portfolio set in Pallet Cloud
item.description:
OpenWorld Portfolio is an interactive, retro Pokémon-inspired 2.5D open-world developer portfolio set in Pallet Cloud. Built completely from scratch with Next.js 16, React 19, and native HTML5 Canvas 2D without third-party game engines, it features interactive buildings, a high-definition Mega Jumbotron TV, a turn-based Pokémon battle arena against Gym Leader Aritro at the Silicon Gym, a Poké Mart skill shopping cart with rich HTML mail requisitions, and an instant-toggle Executive Recruiter Dossier.

Source Code Repository: https://github.com/halcyon-past/openworld-portfolio

Tech Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5 Canvas 2D, Web Audio API, Web Speech API

item.title: Quarantine — Zero-dependency dead-letter queue and fault-tolerance library on PyPI. Wrap Python loops with @quarantine to isolate errors without crashing batch jobs.
item.description:
quarantine is an open-source, zero-dependency Python library that brings dead-letter queue resilience to regular loops and batch data pipelines. When processing thousands of records (e.g., CSV ingestion, scraping, API syncing), an unexpected exception at item #5,247 no longer crashes the entire multi-hour run. quarantine safely isolates the failing item, captures the error and full execution state to disk, and keeps the loop running.

Official Dedicated Webpage: https://pypi.org/project/quarantine-py/

Source Code Repository: https://github.com/halcyon-past/quarantine

Tech Stack: Python 3.9+, PyPI, AsyncIO, CLI, Dead-Letter Queue, Fault Tolerance, Pytest
item.author: aritrosaha2025@gmail.com (Aritro Saha)

item.title: GlideConnect — Virtual mouse control platform using MediaPipe hand-gesture recognition and Google Gemini voice assistant. Published in peer-reviewed IJIRT research.
item.description:
A Final Year Project for VIT, this project demonstrates a novel way to control a computer interface using hand gestures and voice commands. It leverages MediaPipe for real-time gesture recognition, integrates a custom voice assistant named Krishna, and incorporates generative AI (using Google Gemini) for enhanced query responses.
